name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 4 visits over 15 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 15 hours starting 2026-06-22, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
